title: Atomic relay-pool reconfiguration from hydrated relay-settings policy
observed_behavior_before: Canonical 30900 relay-settings hydration stored a safe snapshot, but relay pools were constructed before hydration and did not converge to hydrated ContextVM/service relay topology.
intended_behavior: RelayPool exposes an in-place, locked reconfiguration API that normalizes and deduplicates relay URLs, preserves unchanged relay entries, closes removed entries, and adds new entries without replacing pool pointers.
The relay-settings hydrator invokes a snapshot callback after trusted canonical 30900 state is validated and stored.

The app relay topology coordinator applies hydrated ContextVM and service relay policy to already-constructed control-plane and service pools without mutating shared config.Config and without polling or timeout-based convergence.
out_of_scope: Changing relay-settings event kinds or ContextVM mutation methods.
Changing NIP-86 authorization semantics beyond the separate bahia-ho1r validation closeout.
